name: Four Seasons Safari Lodge Serengeti
positioning: Full-service safari lodge inside central Serengeti National Park
best_for: Families on a first safari (children 8 and over)
Travelers who want resort comforts in the bush
Wildlife lovers visiting May-June or November-December

facts.text: Opened December 2012 with 77 keys: 60 rooms, 12 suites and 5 freestanding villas.
Located in central Serengeti National Park, a UNESCO World Heritage Site.
Access is a roughly 50-minute flight from Arusha to Seronera Airstrip (SEU), then about 50 minutes by Land Cruiser. Driving from Arusha via Ngorongoro and Naabi Gate takes about 8 hours.
Dining: Kula's Restaurant (African-inspired and international), Boma Grill (African), Maji Bar, Sundowner Bar and The Vineyard wine room.
Kijana Klub is a kids' and teens' programme (ages 8 and over) with supervised activities.
Per a third-party review, Terrace Suites have private infinity plunge pools and Horizon Rooms face the waterhole.
The Great Migration totals about 1.7 million wildebeest, 260,000 zebras and 470,000 gazelles. Calving is on the south-eastern short-grass plains in February.
Named in Travel + Leisure's World's Top 100 Hotels (2019).

highlights.text: An outdoor infinity pool overlooks an active waterhole frequented by elephants.
Serengeti Kani Spa has six treatment pavilions; the signature treatment is the 90-minute Kifa Massage.
The Discovery Centre has museum-quality exhibits and a lecture hall.
Elevated wooden walkways keep guests above the animals, and Maasai staff form the security team.

considerations.text: Per a third-party review, herds pass the Seronera area around May-June and November-December; February calving takes place further south on the short-grass plains. Visiting for calving or river crossings means long drives or a different camp.
The lodge is in the public national park, not a private concession, so game drives share roads with other vehicles at popular sightings.
Getting there takes a light-aircraft flight to Seronera plus about a 50-minute drive, or roughly 8 hours by road from Arusha.
Wildlife is close: elephants drink at the waterhole next to the pool, and movement around the lodge is on elevated walkways with Maasai security.

perks.text: With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, breakfast for two is free daily (the standard published rate is room only, with breakfast usually extra).
With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, guests get a priority upgrade if available at check-in.
With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, guests get a $100 hotel credit.
WhataHotel special offers are combinable with the exclusive perks.
